dedupe_keys.name: seznam obcinskih cest v obcini kostel

description: Seznam občinskih cest v Občini Kostel is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KOSTEL. The municipality of Kostel has a total of 50 km of municipal roads, of which 22.9 km are local roads (LC) and 27.1 km are public roads (JP). Coverage: OBČINA KOSTEL. The portal shows the English title as "List of municipal roads in the Municipality of Kostel" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA KOSTEL. Its keywords include javna pot, lokalna cesta, občinske ceste. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
